statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness suspected to be related to underlying nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) was ordered for ambulatory assessment to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or conduction abnormalities contributing to these symptoms.
The service is supported by diagnosis I34.0.
The service is supported by diagnosis R00.2.
The service is supported by diagnosis R42.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-97.
The denial reason is that the requested service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable under current policy guidelines.
